standaloneRustConsumer: passed with the romedb-production profile; 335 registry/git package identities match the workspace lockfile
upgradeRestore: Passed from the 0.2.13 to 0.2.18 packages on Node 22.0.0 and 24.19.0 (groups v0213-upgrade-restore to v0218-upgrade-restore). 0.2.13 is the floor: it changed the stored value prefix, and earlier files are refused.

engine.exceptions: the maintained engine exceptions retained, none added (romedb/docs/core-exceptions.md)
engine.storageFormat: __romedb_ schema prefix, .romedb extension, stored values prefixed RDB 01 (FDB 01 before 0.2.13); openEmbedded and serve use MVCC files; collections with a * array path index use catalog version 8, others keep version 7 or earlier
engine.change: no engine core change; a full-text build writes as many rows per statement as its parameter budget allows; the same engine and patches as 0.2.18 (Turso v0.8.3, Tantivy 0.27.0)

spatial.explainReadsNoData: metered EXPLAIN reports zero rows read for every spatial form (spatial_explain_reads_no_documents_or_index_entries)

supportedScope.ownership: One owning process per database file; shared clients connect to its service

documentationOverrides.ENVELOPE.md: Historical 2.1.0 measurements; the raw-evidence link points to the immutable fastdb-v2.1.0 release

performance: Historical 2.1.0 operating envelope retained; fresh bounded application sample, not capacity guarantees

publication: Qualified for publication; anonymous public-download verification is separate
